full_details: At a little after eight Richard Quiney spoke from the Bell in Carter Lane. His boots were not yet dry. He is up on a brief for a collection through the shires, with certified schedules for the Lord Keeper's men. He has waited on three secretaries and is promised a fourth, and he looks for the seal within ten days. He said two hundred houses, one fire with another. You counted about twenty from a ladder in August, and you said so. He called twenty this year's count, and the two hundred the town's whole affliction. He wanted a word carried to my Lord Chamberlain. You said my lord's gentleman laughs at players and would not weep for malt-barns. He asked a supper at the least, and did not name the day. He gave you a taste of home, a little improved in the telling: your father's barley dry in the loft, ten quarters, and your boy's Latin with never a blot. You did not ask the two pounds he still owes, and you did not lend. You told him to send when his gentlemen have done. At two you played in The Two Gentlemen of Verona. At the reckoning Heminges set next week and did not read a sum. Monday the house is dark. Tuesday you are Gaunt. Wednesday the lovers are read at Holywell, and you are not in the Shrew. Thursday Navarre. Friday the Shrew. Saturday Two Gentlemen. Thursday's seven shillings is already entered. The Rose had Seven Days. You did not go. Anne's letter is still unanswered.
one_sentence: Quiney spoke from the Bell of two hundred houses, the two pounds stayed out, and the company set next week.
title: Two hundred houses, and next week set
